title: Unbelievably solid
body: Leagues above all the usual sloppy apps for these purposes, extremely tight design.

title: Simple, functional and visually pleasing
body:
I have never before encountered such a functional yet aesthetically pleasing and simple tracker app. I love the colours and the ability to group trackers.
This is exactly what I have been looking for, thank you.
author: Utu S.

title: Nice app
body: Simple app with nice design and convenient widgets, works good for me.
